name: Desktop Ponies

description.en: A desktop customization application that places animated My Little Pony characters on the desktop. The .NET project documents support for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

developer: Desktop Ponies team (repository maintained by RoosterDragon)
historicalNotes: The 2012 SourceForge files document an early Windows build. The later repository describes cross-platform support. This record covers the desktop overlay, not the separately maintained browser and Linux reimplementations.

events.title: Early Desktop Ponies test build
events.description: The project’s SourceForge file index lists the Windows test build 1.42 TEST 1 in May 2012.

events.title: Desktop Ponies 1.69
